checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Open hands rest beside body, palms down.
checks.feet: Supine body stays supported while straight legs open and cross, alternating which leg passes above.
checks.movement: Lie supine with arms beside body, palms down and neutral head on low cushion. Straight raised legs open and cross horizontally, changing upper leg at the next crossing. Two open-cross-open cycles in eight seconds with back supported.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative; lower only while keeping the back supported.
